mentions.heading: Claims related to the manufacture, performance, or use of our products
mentions.detail: Damages may exceed revenue since integrated systems cost more; some contracts don't exclude consequential damages; insurance insufficient
mentions.quote: Because the systems into which our products are integrated have a higher cost of goods than the products we sell, the expenses and damages we are asked to pay may be significantly higher than the revenue and profits we received.

mentions.heading: Exposure to claims in safety-critical end markets
mentions.detail: Sales into automotive, aerospace, defense, safety, security, medical where failures could damage property or persons
mentions.quote: Further, we sell to customers in industries such as automotive, aerospace, defense, safety, security, and medical, where failure of the application could cause damage to property or persons.

mentions.heading: Our contractual relationships with our customers expose us to risks and liabilities
mentions.detail: No long-term contracts; ~101,000 customers, top ten ~11% of fiscal 2026 revenue; backlog push-outs fiscal 2023-2025
mentions.quote: Also, many of our customers felt the effects of slowing economic activity and increasing business uncertainty, and customer requests to push-out or cancel backlog and our accommodation of their requests increased in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2023 and continued throughout fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025.

mentions.heading: Unfavorable negotiated customer contract terms
mentions.detail: Agreed to uncapped IP infringement/product failure liability and liquidated damages to win designs
mentions.quote: In order to win important designs, avoid losing business to competitors, maintain existing business, or be permitted to bid on new business, we have, and may in the future, have to agree to uncapped liability for such items as intellectual property infringement or product failure, or have to agree to liquidated damage provisions.
